title: Eve Meeting Note Pull Reconciler Authority

responsibilities.unknown_policy: The reconciler is a pull-only loop closer: it may read Eve session streams through the authenticated EveSessionClient and write meeting notes exclusively through workflowService.recordMeetingNoteGeneration, whose source_text_hash equality gate stays the write-back validator of record. A stream tool-call is only trusted when its source_text_hash and run_id match the dispatch run's persisted metadata.meeting_note_generation; anything else is never written back. Sessions that end without a matching note are surfaced as blocked dispatch runs (operator_review_eve_session) instead of being polled forever, transient failures leave run state untouched for retry, and the human publish approval (approve_meeting_note_publish) stays in Brainbase untouched by this worker.
